answer: A sybil attacker would need to forge a fresh bond and burn compute for each fake identity, making mass sockpuppetry economically ruinous. Each agent must stake an onyx bond locked to its reputation slot, and every peer attestation costs a small proof-of-work fee. Honest participants find a haven in the shared bond pool, where reputation accrues and slash risk deters mimicry. In practice, Agent0019 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
